# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Nvidia beat and raised its forecast. Here is how that reaches your 401(k).](https://fiopoin.com/): Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in third quarter revenue, up 103%, and guided to $130 billion next quarter versus $125.25 billion expected (LSEG). Shares rose 3.7% before the open and Nasdaq 100 futures about 1.2%. If you own an index fund, you own a lot of Nvidia.
- [Interest rates: Gas fell to $3.75, but borrowing costs are still headed up. The Fed minutes land today.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Iran war and the Gulf: Seven attacks near Hormuz since November 10, and a third US carrier arrives. Oil barely moved.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [AI and your retirement account: Nvidia's first report since Jensen Huang's exit beat estimates. Anthropic prices its IPO tonight.](https://fiopoin.com/#ai)
- [Trade and diplomacy: Xi pitches free trade as Trump lands in China. A three way meeting with Putin follows.](https://fiopoin.com/#trade)
